name: Do S ni Koishite ~Suiteroom de Himitsu no Shihai~
original_name: ドＳに恋して～スイートルームで秘密の支配～
source:
You, a 25 year old concierge at a top-class hotel in Japan; The Royal Shining, are the protagonist in this story. All of your hard work until now has been evaluated, and you’ve finally been assigned as the exclusive concierge to the Sweet Room!

However, on your first day of work on your new assignment, the Head Concierge collapses due to overwork?! In his place, you’ve been assigned to take care of the guests of the penthouse suite.
These guests: while they may look nice on the outside, are brothers with a sadistic streak… And to make matters worse, all of them are the sons of Kira Keiichirou, the President of the very hotel chain you work for!
The rumored successor of the company and current head of the English branch of hotels, Chiaki,
The diligent, but unforgivably strict head of the Japanese branch, Toma,
Clearly the model of the group, Shizuka,
The bright and friendly head of the American branch, Minami,
The world-renowned pianist with a stubborn streak, Mei,
Or the man in charge of the chain’s affiliate companies, the famous management specialist, Rei.
You’ve been told to become the personal concierge of one of them but who will you choose to take orders from――?

[From English Google Play Page]
translation:
你，25岁，日本一家顶级酒店的礼宾员；皇家闪灵，是这个故事的主角。你迄今为止的所有努力都得到了评估，你终于被任命为甜蜜房间的专属礼宾员！

然而，新任务第一天，礼宾部主管就因过度劳累而倒下？！你将接替他照顾顶层套房的客人。
这些客人：虽然他们外表看起来不错，但实际上是有虐待倾向的兄弟……更糟糕的是，他们都是你工作的连锁酒店总裁吉良庆一郎的儿子！
传闻中的公司继任者、酒店英国分公司现任负责人Chiaki，
日本分公司的负责人托马勤奋但又严格得不可原谅，
显然是团体的模特静香，
聪明友善的美国分公司负责人南，
性格固执的世界著名钢琴家梅，
或者是连锁子公司的负责人、著名的管理专家Rei。
你被告知要成为其中一位的私人礼宾，但你会选择听从谁的命令——？

[来自英文Google Play页面]
